name: pnp-spfx-copilot-components-site-snapshot
title: Site Snapshot - SharePoint Site Health Copilot App
shortDescription: On-demand health snapshot of a SharePoint site inside Microsoft 365 Copilot: a transparent health score, stale documents, external sharing, duplicates, large and empty files, and a file-type breakdown.
longDescription: Site Snapshot is a Copilot UX Component that scans every user document library on a SharePoint site through the brokered Microsoft Graph client and returns a 0-100 health score built from five explained sub-scores: storage, freshness, sharing exposure, activity and tidiness.

Inline, it renders a compact score card in the chat. In fullscreen it opens a dashboard with tabs for file types, owners, duplicates, stale files, external and Anyone sharing, empty files and the largest files. The agent can open straight to the view the user asked about.
Users can export the results to CSV or email themselves a summary, and ask the agent follow-up questions answered from the snapshot results. The component is read-only.
